paragraphs.text: DLS — DSH Download Server: a global, session-aware, persistent download queue for DeepSeek Harness.

**DLS** — DSH Download Server
A global download service for DeepSeek Harness: visible across session
s, owned per session, persistent queue, pausable and resumable.
Every existing DSH downloader is one tool function that blocks until the file lands. They make downl
oads **fast**; they don't solve three things:

- the download dies when the session or the turn ends
- there is no queue, no pause, no resume
- not
DLS is the **queue layer**, not the transport layer.
